headline: Approved minutes from July 8, 2026 and July 15, 2026; discussed residency enforcement and school choice policy sections.
summary: The Policy Subcommittee accepted the agenda and approved minutes from July 8, 2026 and July 15, 2026. Members reviewed Section I and Section J of the policy manual, discussing residency enforcement, charter school enrollment, school choice, and truancy issues, and talked about a timeline for finishing the policy review.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: Member McCarthy Sirois made a motion to approve the minutes for July 8, 2026. Member Keegan seconded the motion. VOTE: PASSED 3-0
MOTION: Member McCarthy Sirois made a motion to approve the minutes for July 15, 2026. Member Keegan seconded the motion. VOTE: PASSED 3-0
